title: Inventory Count Exception Report
subtitle: Warehouse Inventory Count: preserves facts, evidence, and actions.
description: Inventory Count Exception Report covers item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance. The inventory control coordinator records Warehouse Inventory Count chronology, evidence, containment, and effectiveness. Inventory Count Exception Report keeps Warehouse Inventory Count exceptions visible until the inventory control coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Inventory Count Exception Report at warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record. Document item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance identity before Warehouse Inventory Count begins. Compare item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance findings with stated Warehouse Inventory Count criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Inventory Count issues to authorized inventory reviewer. For Inventory Count Exception Report, confirm requirements for Warehouse Inventory Count. Ask authorized inventory reviewer to review Warehouse Inventory Count conditions beyond the inventory control coordinator's role.
